# addr: # namer 5/8 (docs/research/naming_g5.md): semantic names need >= 2 independent evidence pieces; rows with a generic name document behaviour without asserting a purpose

name: CommTime_ShowSummary
evidence: Shows this session's connection-time summary (404A, only if timer A ran), adds timer A to the stored total (425F -> C2D8..DA), clears timer A (C2D4..D7), saves the 4 total bytes to SRAM bank1 A9F8..A9FB; callers 24, 4E (7), 7F; 5 scenarios

name: CommTime_DrawSummaryScreen
evidence: LCD off, loads tiles/palette/map (2 packs by C2C3), prints session minutes (C2D6) and seconds (C2D5), clamped at 59:59, as digit tile pairs at $D162/$D167, waits for A; returns at once if timer A never ran (4239); 18 scenarios

name: CommTime_DrawNumber
evidence: HL=value BC=-divisor DE=map ptr: counts how many times the divisor fits (add hl,bc loop), draws that digit with CommTime_PutDigit (suppressing leading zeros via hRam_FFB4) and returns the remainder in HL; used with -100 and -10

name: CommTime_PutDigit
evidence: A=0..9, DE=map cell: writes the top tile at [DE] and bottom tile at [DE+$20] from Table_CommTime_DigitTiles (pairs at $4225+2*A) and attr $08 at +$400 / +$420

name: Table_CommTime_DigitTiles
evidence: 10 (top, bottom) tile-id pairs for digits 0-9 ($67/$77, $68/$78, ... $6E/$7F) read by CommTime_PutDigit with de = $4225 + 2*a

name: CommTime_TimerAIsNonZero
evidence: Returns A!=0 if any of C2D4..C2D7 (timer A frames/seconds/minutes/+1) is non-zero, i.e. a connection was timed since the last reset; callers: mail screens 22/23/27 and CommTime_DrawSummaryScreen

name: CommTime_Reset
evidence: Zeroes the stored total C2D8..C2DB and timer A C2D4..C2D7; called at session start by Browser_BeginSession (4E:46A3) and from the mail screens (22/23/27)

name: CommTime_AddTimerA
evidence: Adds timer A (C2D4 frames, C2D5 seconds, C2D6 minutes) to the total (C2D8..C2DA), carrying at 60 (binary, not BCD); results hRam_FFB0..B2 = frames, seconds, minutes, clamped to 59:59; callers 51:4000, 4E:5FB9, 68

name: Tilemap_CommTime_SummaryA
evidence: Map + attr (20x18 each) of the summary screen with tiles $42A0/$46A0 (C2C3=1): "つうしんがしゅうりょうしました。こんかいのつうしんじかんは  ふん  びょうでした。" (communication ended; this time N min N sec) and a bottom bar "A 次へ"

name: Tilemap_CommTime_SummaryB
evidence: Map + attr of the summary screen with tiles $4DB0/$51B0 (C2C3=0, mail/browser variant): the same sentence as Tilemap_CommTime_SummaryA, button hint "A すすむ" instead of "A 次へ"

name: Bmp_Validate
evidence: HL=file data in SRAM bank 3: Bmp_ParseHeader then Bmp_CheckSize; A=1 when the 1-bit BMP is acceptable (docs/research/mobile_trainer_product_notes.md 'BMP header validator'); callers 4C:4E56 (image URL wrapper) and 74; 1 scenario

name: Bmp_ParseHeader
evidence: Requires 'B' 'M', reads the data offset (BC), width byte -> hRam_FFD6, height byte -> hRam_FFD7, top-down flag -> C33F, planes=1, bpp=1, compression 0, colours-used 0; returns HL = data start + BC and A=1 or A=0 on any mismatch

name: Bmp_CheckSize
evidence: Accepts width <= $90 (144) and height 1..$60 (96) taken from hRam_FFD6/FFD7; A=1 if the image fits the 144x96 viewport of the page renderer

name: Bmp_ConvertToTiles
evidence: HL=BMP in SRAM bank 3: validates, compares the two colour-table sums (Bmp_ColorSum) for the invert flag (C331 bit7), pads rows to 32 bits, re-packs them into 8-pixel strips (WRAM bank 3 $D000), fixes type-4 element pointers; caller 74:53B9

name: Table_Bmp_RowEndMask
evidence: 9 bit masks $FF,$7F,$3F,$1F,$0F,$07,$03,$01,$00 (not a palette): OR-ed into the last byte of a bitmap row for width%8 = 1..7 at 51:7276-7286 to set the unused pixel bits

name: Bmp_ColorSum
evidence: HL=colour-table entry (B,G,R,pad): returns DE = 2*(B+G+R) and HL advanced by 4; called twice by Bmp_ConvertToTiles to order the two palette entries by brightness

name: Bmp_RoundUpToTextRow
evidence: A=pixel count: returns A = 12 * ceil(A/12) (Divide32by15 by 12, remainder test, then *12); 2 callers in Bmp_ConvertToTiles for width and height, so images cover whole 12-px text rows

name: Image_BlitToTileCanvas
evidence: A=style (FFC2 -> FFD0), HL=1-bit image rows in SRAM bank 3, BC/DE clip offsets from Browser_DrawElement: shifts each row by the x offset (74E6 masks, 7517, unrolled 76AB..78B7) into the WRAM tile canvas (banks 2/3 at $D000); caller 4E:5B5C

name: Image_MakeEdgeMasks
evidence: D = image x position, [FFD6] = width: hRam_FFD1 = left-edge pixel mask ($FF when aligned, else (1<<(8-(D&7)))-1), hRam_FFD2 = right-edge mask from (D+width)&7; used by Image_BlitToTileCanvas

name: Image_BlitEdgeStrip
evidence: One tile column of a partial (edge) strip: shifts the source left by [FFD5] bits, masks with FFD1/FFD2 and writes two bitplane bytes per pixel row as chosen by the style [FFD0] (bits 0/4 and 1/5: zero, data, inverted data or ones)

name: Image_BlitStripShift0
evidence: Inner loop for a full tile column, shift 0 (chosen by [FFD5] at 51:75F8): C pixel rows, two bitplane bytes each per style [FFD0], destination +$0E after each pair (next pixel row of the tile); run in browser_pages

name: Image_BlitStripShift1
evidence: Same as Image_BlitStripShift0 with the source pair shifted left by 1 bit (rla / rl b once); dispatched by [FFD5] = 1; not executed

name: Image_BlitStripShift2
evidence: Same with a 2-bit shift (two rla/rl b); dispatched by [FFD5] = 2; not executed

name: Image_BlitStripShift3
evidence: Same with a 3-bit shift; dispatched by [FFD5] = 3; not executed

name: Image_BlitStripShift4
evidence: Same for shift 4 (merges the nibbles of the byte pair with swap); chosen by [FFD5] = 4 (bit2 set, bits1/0 clear); not executed

name: Image_BlitStripShift5
evidence: Same for shift amount 5; dispatched by [FFD5] = 5; not executed

name: Image_BlitStripShift6
evidence: Same for shift amount 6; dispatched by [FFD5] = 6; not executed

name: Image_BlitStripShift7
evidence: Same for shift 7 (rr b / rra of the byte pair); chosen by [FFD5] = 7; not executed
